subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this umbrella stay open until focused Anthropic signed-thinking prevention lands, or should maintainers close it in favor of the narrower remaining replay issue now that the recovery carriers landed?
rationale: The remaining work changes Claude-family thinking replay semantics and overlaps multiple open PRs with compatibility/provider/message-delivery risk, so automation should not choose the final policy.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open while reviewing the focused prevention PR and close only after the chosen fix lands or the remaining variants are formally split.

options.title: Make Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Close this issue only after posting a clear handoff to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 and its linked prevention PR.

options.title: Accept Recovery-Only Mitigation
options.body: Treat the landed recovery PRs as sufficient for this umbrella and defer prevention policy to a later provider replay review.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open while reviewing the focused prevention PR and close only after the chosen fix lands or the remaining variants are formally split.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice centers on the Claude thinking-block preservation policy introduced in that history.
